testRunner_comment: The tap runner executes each test file directly (node <file>), which keeps it in the same process as Stryker coverage hook. Running them via `node --test` forks a child per file, the hook records nothing, and every mutant reports NoCoverage.
mutate_comment: Domain, use cases and pure backend contracts are measured by port-level unit tests. Host adapters require native verification.
incremental_comment: Incremental mode is off: a full run takes about half a minute with per-test analysis, so the complexity and the risk of a stale incremental report are not worth it.
tap_comment: The fast-check settings file pins the seed and the case count for a campaign only, so every mutant meets the same inputs; everywhere else the properties run on fast-check's defaults. See tests/unit/fast-check-mutation.cjs.
